international.title: US air travel slowly recovers from nationwide flight ground stop as chaos continues
international.summary: Thousands of flights still canceled as officials blamed ageing air control system for nationwide grounding Travel chaos continued across the US on Saturday morning as airlines scrambled to recover from a four-hour nationwide Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) ground stop that delayed or canceled thousands of the flights. On Saturday morning, more than 3,000 flights within, into or out of the US had already been canceled, according to FlightAware . Continue reading...
